title: Fix TTFT instrumentation for streaming: stamp on first non-empty chunk write
author: Nadia Rahman
description:
Context: During telemetry validation (client-measured vs server-measured) we found a systematic TTFT mismatch for *streaming* responses in cases where the first network chunk is either (a) metadata-only (e.g. message_start) or (b) an empty/whitespace-only delta that gets coalesced by the streaming writer. Our TTFT metric was being stamped when the stream was initialized / first event enqueued, not when the first *token-carrying* chunk was actually written to the socket. This made TTFT look artificially good for some shapes, and in a few cases produced negative/near-zero TTFT deltas when combined with client-side parsing and buffering.

What this PR changes: 1) Introduces a single source of truth for streaming TTFT stamping: we now set `ttft_ts` on the first *non-empty token delta* that is actually written (flush boundary) to the HTTP stream writer. 2) Avoids stamping TTFT on metadata-only events (`message_start`, `tool_call_start`, etc.). 3) Adds a debug-only annotation (`stream_first_chunk_kind`) to help identify when TTFT was stamped on a token delta vs a tool delta vs a metadata frame (should be token delta in normal chat streaming). 4) Updates unit/integration tests to cover the problematic path (first event metadata-only + subsequent token chunk).

Definition note (aligns with current baseline docs): TTFT is time from request received (server) to first emitted token in the streaming payload. This is *not* time-to-first-byte and it is *not* time-to-first-stream-event if the event does not contain tokens.

Why now: This was uncovered as part of the TTFT/TPOT telemetry validation harness work and is blocking perf-baseline comparability for streaming shapes.

Rollout/risk: Low risk; metric-only change + localized streaming writer hook. No API response changes. Metric name unchanged; only the timestamp source changes. We will watch for a one-time step-change in TTFT for streaming traffic in dashboards.

Screenshots/validation: See ENG-4832 notes; local run of `tools/telemetry_validation/compare_ttft.py` now shows <3ms median delta between client and server TTFT for streaming shapes (previously ~40–120ms depending on coalescing).
commits: telemetry(streaming): stamp TTFT on first token chunk write
tests: cover metadata-first streaming TTFT edge case
changed_areas: Serving runtime streaming response writer + telemetry instrumentation. No scheduler/kernel changes.

review_conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Can we confirm we’re not accidentally changing TTFT semantics to first-byte? The hook is on writer flush; if the chunk contains only metadata we should still ignore it per current definition.

Nadia Rahman (author): Yep — we gate stamping on `frame.kind == token_delta` *and* `token_count_delta > 0`. Metadata-only frames do not stamp. The flush hook is just the point where we can reliably say the token delta is actually emitted.

Marcus Reed (review): Any chance we stamp on whitespace-only token chunks? We have a few paths that can emit "\n" or " " early depending on prompt formatting.

Nadia Rahman (author): Good call. We use `token_count_delta` from the encoder, not string length; whitespace tokens still count as tokens and should count for TTFT per baseline definition. (If we want “first non-whitespace token” that’s a product/spec change; not doing here.)

Allison Grant (review): Please ensure `stream_first_chunk_kind` is debug-only and not exploding cardinality.

Nadia Rahman (author): It’s an attribute on the structured log event only (sampled), not a metric label. Added a comment + test to ensure we never export it as a metric dimension.

Sofia Ivanova (review): This is telemetry-only, but does it affect backpressure timing? Any blocking in the writer path?

Nadia Rahman (author): No additional blocking; callback is invoked inline after serialization (we’re already on that path). It’s a single atomic compare-exchange for first stamp.

Logan Wright (approval): LGTM after the metric docs update.

Nadia Rahman (author): Updated docs + rebased.

Marcus Reed (approval): Approved.

Allison Grant (approval): Approved.
release_notes: Internal: Streaming TTFT telemetry now stamps on first token-carrying chunk write (fixes metadata-first/empty-first chunk edge case).
